f3_program: collection("parking_lot.sections", "section", "parking_lot", source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
observe(at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), 1000, "count", source("A 1000 car parking lot"))
observe(at("parking_lot.sections.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("3 sections"))
member("parking_lot.sections", "parking_lot.section_1", source("320 spaces in section 1"))
member("parking_lot.sections", "parking_lot.section_2", source("200 more in section 2 than in section 3"))
member("parking_lot.sections", "parking_lot.section_3", source("200 more in section 2 than in section 3"))
partition("parking_lot.sections", at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
observe(at("parking_lot.section_1.spaces.count", "current"), 320, "count", source("320 spaces in section 1"))

sum_relation(at("parking_lot.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_1.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_3.spaces.count", "current"), source("parking lot is divided into 3 sections"))
offset(at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"), at("parking_lot.section_3.spaces.count", "current"), 200, "count", source("200 more in section 2 than in section 3"))
query("value", at("parking_lot.section_2.spaces.count", "current"))
assumptions: The phrase "1000 car parking lot" denotes the parking lot's total space capacity.

f3_program: collection("area.other_houses", "house", "area", source("houses in the area"))

offset(at("area.certain_house.construction_cost", "current"), at("area.other_houses.construction_cost_per_house", "current"), 100000, "currency", source("The cost of building a certain house in an area is 100,000 more than the construction cost of each of the houses in the area"))
multiple(at("area.certain_house.sale_price", "current"), at("area.other_houses.sale_price_per_house", "current"), 1.5, source("it sells for 1.5 times as much as the other houses"))
observe(at("area.other_houses.sale_price_per_house", "current"), 320000, "dollar", source("which sell at $320,000 each"))

difference_relation(at("area.certain_house.profit", "current"), at("area.certain_house.sale_price", "current"), at("area.certain_house.construction_cost", "current"), source("profit is made by spending the extra money to build"))

difference_relation(at("area.other_houses.profit_per_house", "current"), at("area.other_houses.sale_price_per_house", "current"), at("area.other_houses.construction_cost_per_house", "current"), source("profit is made by spending the extra money to build"))
query("difference", at("area.other_houses.profit_per_house", "current"), at("area.certain_house.profit", "current"))
assumptions: Profit is represented as sale price minus construction cost, as implied by the question.
No year-to-month conversion is assumed because it is absent from the source and F3-v1.
The repeated "Granted" row cannot be uniquely grounded with F3-v1's cell(row label, column label) evidence form.

f3_program: collection("tina.sales.books", "book", "tina.sales", source("each book she sells"))
collection("tina.sales.customers", "customer", "tina.sales", source("every customer"))
observe(at("tina.sales.books.revenue_per_book", "current"), 20, "dollar", source("$20 for each book she sells"))
observe(at("tina.sales.profit", "current"), 120, "dollar", source("$120 profit on her sales"))
observe(at("tina.sales.books.production_cost_per_book", "current"), 5, "dollar", source("each book costs $5 to make"))
product_relation(at("tina.sales.revenue", "current"), at("tina.sales.books.revenue_per_book", "current"), at("tina.sales.books.count", "current"), source("$20 for each book she sells"))

product_relation(at("tina.sales.production_cost", "current"), at("tina.sales.books.production_cost_per_book", "current"), at("tina.sales.books.count", "current"), source("each book costs $5 to make"))
difference_relation(at("tina.sales.profit", "current"), at("tina.sales.revenue", "current"), at("tina.sales.production_cost", "current"), source("$120 profit on her sales"))
multiple(at("tina.sales.books.count", "current"), at("tina.sales.customers.count", "current"), 2, source("every customer buys 2 at a time"))
query("value", at("tina.sales.customers.count", "current"))
assumptions: Profit is represented as sales revenue minus production cost, as implied by the question.
